name: Terilogy Holdings Corporation
summary: Terilogy Holdings Corporation, established in Tokyo, Japan, in 1989 as Terilogy Co., Ltd., provides IP network and cybersecurity products and solutions to businesses in Japan and globally. It distributes network hardware and software including DNS/DHCP systems, routers, switches and wireless LAN technology, and offers service packages such as rental servers, mobile data communication, managed VPNs, web conferencing and internet access for business.
